The structure of Ba8Mo4Ge8S24 (Ba2MoGe2S6) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 44 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ge and Mo each adopt octahedral coordination by six S neighbors, while Ba is surrounded by 12 S neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement; the neighbor graph is three-dimensional. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Ge and Mo octahedra, and face-sharing between Ba and both Ge and Mo polyhedra.
